text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication ensures that only the right people can access accounts and sensitive information. Developers must also use input validation to check what users enter, which helps prevent attacks. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, can be avoided with careful coding and regular testing. By focusing on these key areas, developers can build safer websites and protect both their users and their data from online threats.
